Critics Consensus A visually dazzling space odyssey that's carried along effortlessly by the gravitational pull of Ryan Gosling at his most winning, Project Hail Mary is a near-miraculous fusion of smarts and heart. Read Critics Reviews Audience Says One stellar Gosling + one arachnid-ish alien + one Hail Mary mission = lightning in a spaceship. Read Audience Reviews John Anderson America Magazine 2d “Project Hail Mary” certainly qualifies as an uplifting experience at the cinema, being a mix of selflessness, sacrifice, camaraderie and even a certain amount of melancholy. Go to Full Review Sara Michelle Fetters MovieFreak.com 2d As far as rousing, interstellar science fiction pulp adventures are concerned, directors Phil Lord and Christopher Miller pull out all the stops with the monumentally entertaining Project Hail Mary. Go to Full Review RW 31m Visually stunning. pretty faithful to the major story beats of the book. Rocky steals the show! Amaze Amaze Amaze! Christine 32m Great movie. Ryan Gosling is awesome, Beautifully filmed, combination of humor, tension and bittersweet emotions. Loved it!! As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction... but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.
